notes.title: Shadelight release
notes.notes:
Hi!

I want to proudly announce that i just released my first horror game "The Shadelight". It's not a huge production, but I've always wanted to do something like hide and seek with a demanding AI, and I hope i achieved that. If you are interested, please try it :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2050960/The_Shadelight/

For those waiting for some information on squeakers III, I have good news, the completion of Shadelight means I'm back to work on Squeakers III. This time with a larger world to explore :)

Cheers.
